description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceDue" name="Service due notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment made in app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police App" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car Owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Owner_Facility_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarBrought" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Owner_Police_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_CarBrought" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Police_Owner_ServiceDue" name="Service due notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner" messageRef="Msg_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Facility_Owner_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Owner" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Facility_Owner_RepairDone" name="Repair done" sourceRef="SendTask_RepairDone" targetRef="Participant_Owner" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Owner_Facility_Payment" name="Payment made in app" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Facility_Police_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed" sourceRef="Throw_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of due service" messageRef="Msg_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarBrought_Police" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Timer30Days" name="30 days after notification">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit recorded"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Car is registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P6" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Catch_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P7" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Catch_Timer30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P8" sourceRef="Catch_CarBrought" targetRef="End_VisitRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P9" sourceRef="Catch_Timer30Days" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P10" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarBrought_Facility" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Start repair and updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Repair" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Send status update via email" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair and updates finished"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and issue Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RepairDone" name="Notify repair done" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Payment" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Throw_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted_Throw" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Facility" name="Service finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarBrought" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F3" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F4" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F5" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F6" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F7" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F8" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccess" targetRef="SendTask_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F9" sourceRef="SendTask_RepairDone" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F10" sourceRef="Catch_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F11" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Throw_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F12" sourceRef="Throw_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="End_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
